opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Outline Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible applicants will already be employed by the eligible institution or be academics who have maintained close links with that institution following retirement. Applications can be submitted by those holding contract research posts, provided that their appointment continues for a period at least equal to the span of the requested award. Up to three co-applicants from the same or different institutions may also be included. Overseas co-applicants are allowable.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education, to undertake an innovative and original research project.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: The Trust will contribute 100% of the Fellow’s total salary costs (including National Insurance, superannuation and London allowance, where applicable) up to a maximum of £56,000 in year one of the award. The Trust will then contribute 50% of the Fellow’s total salary costs up to a maximum of £28,000 in years two and three, and the balance is to be paid by the host university.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not yet have held a full-time permanent academic post in a UK university or non-UK institution, nor may Fellows hold such a post concurrently with the Early Career Fellowship. The Trust will consider applications from candidates whose permanent post does not include any research.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers, with a research record but who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Up to £5 million is available for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The scheme is open to applications from any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right. A Leverhulme Research Centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions. Collaborative research centres are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that will extend beyond the duration of the Fellowship. Applicants must be experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties from undertaking or completing a research programme.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: The awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: To be eligible to apply for a Research Leadership Award at the time of application, you must have had at least two years full-time or equivalent experience in a research or teaching post in a university after the date of your PhD award. You must already hold a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent, or be nominated for the award by a UK university that undertakes to offer a contract for the duration of the award, with the expectation that a permanent role would be offered by the end of the award.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars who are embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible organisations will be specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence the delivery of outstanding quality teaching within their field. Institutions may make only one application in each round of this scheme.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas, to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research, within the UK.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible organisations will be specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence the delivery of outstanding quality teaching within their field. Institutions may make only one application in each round of this scheme.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide training opportunities across the fine and performing arts: music, drama, dance, film, fine art, etc.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible organisations will be specialist arts training institutions that can demonstrate outstanding quality teaching within their particular field and who offer degrees at either undergraduate or postgraduate taught level. Institutions may make only one application for funding in each round of this scheme.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide support to undergraduate and/or postgraduate students across the fine and performing arts, including (but not exclusively) music, drama, dance, film, fine art, etc.
